Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step. After correctly identifying that Michel de Salzmann was born in 1923 and Nicolas Görtler in 1990, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the person born in 1923 (Michel) is "younger" than the person born in 1990 (Nicolas). In reality, a person born in 1923 is older than a person born in 1990. The Planner confused the direction of the age comparison (interpreting an earlier birth date as being "younger" or "more recently born").
